name: PolypGen recurrent-memory development protocol v1
purpose: Select recurrent-memory hyperparameters and compare fixed-gain and learned-Kalman updates.
locked_test_requirement: A new, never-consulted external dataset or prospectively held-out cohort is required before journal-level final testing.
selection_rule: Maximise per-sequence polyp-frame Dice - 0.5 x empty-frame false-positive rate on validation only.
fixed_gain_control: Sweep alpha on validation only; freeze the selected alpha before the locked test. Keep the full RKN checkpoint, detector, re-detection, presence gate and pointer gate identical.
reporting: Report every seed, mean and standard deviation; perform paired tests over videos on the locked test only.
